final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining, SUM(amount - spent) AS sum_difference FROM budget WHERE amount >= 75 GROUP BY category), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(sum_difference) AS avg_sum_difference FROM step1) SELECT step1.category, step1.avg_remaining, step1.sum_difference, step1.sum_difference - step2.avg_sum_difference AS difference_from_average FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step2.avg_sum_difference IS NOT NULL WHERE step1.sum_difference > step2.avg_sum_difference
